blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Sunshine Hills Woods. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Sunshine Hills Woods, North Delta: 22 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 2 of 4 North Delta communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the North Delta total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Sunshine Hills Woods fell from 23 in June to 22 in September (−4.3%), and 10 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 31.0% of North Delta’s 71 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Sunshine Hills Woods?
Sunshine Hills Woods also had 50 houses listed and 3 sold in September, against 22 condos and townhomes listed. The Sunshine Hills Woods houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Sunshine Hills Woods home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

16 townhomes sold in Sunshine Hills Woods with a median price of $743,500 (the middle half sold between $636,750 and $930,000), taking a median of 32 days to sell at 97.0% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $478 per square foot, a median year built of 1988 and a median strata fee of $476 a month. 6 condos sold in Sunshine Hills Woods with a median price of $582,500, taking a median of 46 days to sell at 95.4% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $635 per square foot, a median year built of 2021 and a median strata fee of $406 a month.

Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Sunshine Hills Woods?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 22 condos and townhomes listed in Sunshine Hills Woods. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Sunshine Hills Woods a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Sunshine Hills Woods had a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Sunshine Hills Woods from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 10 condos and townhomes sold in Sunshine Hills Woods over those 4 months, out of 35 in all of North Delta.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Sunshine Hills Woods sell for?
faq.a: 16 townhomes sold in Sunshine Hills Woods between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $743,500.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Sunshine Hills Woods?
faq.a: The median was 32 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.0% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
